variables.name: COLDPIN_PRIVATE_SCOPES
variables.title: Private npm Scopes (comma-separated)
variables.description: Internal npm scopes routed exclusively to your private registry (for example @acme,@acme-internal). Never queried against public registry.npmjs.org or api.osv.dev.

variables.name: COLDPIN_PRIVATE_REGISTRY_URL
variables.title: Private npm Registry URL (HTTPS)
variables.description: HTTPS private npm registry endpoint (for example https://artifactory.acme.internal/api/npm/npm-local). Must be HTTPS and non-metadata/non-loopback.

variables.name: COLDPIN_REGISTRY_TOKEN
variables.title: Private Registry Read-Only Token
variables.description: Least-privilege read-only bearer token sent strictly over HTTPS to the exact configured private registry host. Never passed via CLI args.
